author: Jason Stys
summary: Compare unpublished maintenance standards against the same ledger, time and workload, exposing component findings and deadline deltas.
rationale: Lets authorized reviewers assess standards changes before altering maintenance records or policy.
limitations: Hypothetical configured thresholds and constant workloads, not manufacturer approval or probabilistic component-life predictions.
Draft comparisons do not publish a maintenance standard, alter the ledger or authorize service/flight.
No live fleet/hardware integration is supplied; local data is unencrypted and trusts the OS owner.
Source-first project with current package/service validation; no public native desktop application release is supplied.

visualReview.method: Every rendered page individually viewed at readable original resolution

scope: Reviewed documentation editions of the cited source. Checksums identify bytes, not authorship. Historical measurements retain their own dates; integration CI must be checked separately.
